What are the latest nuclear fusion records?

Recent experiments at the National Ignition Facility (NIF) demonstrated net energy gain with a target gain factor greater than 1.8 [1]. Simultaneously, commercial magnetic confinement ventures utilizing high-temperature superconductors (HTS) have validated 20 Tesla magnet operation [2].
